name: Angles
overview: Scripture reveals that angels are powerful, created beings who serve God's purposes, including protecting believers as seen in Psalms 91:11 and delivering God's people as in Acts 12:7. They possess a human-like appearance in some visions (Ezekiel 1:5) and are limited in knowledge, for example, not knowing the exact time of Christ's return (Matthew 24:36). Believers are encouraged to show hospitality, as some have unknowingly entertained angels (Hebrews 13:2), while Scripture also warns of angels who rebelled and were reserved for judgment (Jude 1:6).
